name: photo-frame
description: A framed photo of a drawn family character (our style: paper face, ink outline, Chillar's half-closed deadpan eyes, seeded hair/outfit so each reel's character is unique) on a paper mat, optional `caption` below, and a speech bubble from someone off-screen above it. Params: speech (bubble text), speaker (small name under the speech, optional), caption (under the photo, e.g. 'didi'), who: didi | mummy | papa | chacha | dadi | bhai | mausi | uncle | hr | dost (default: read from the caption — mummy/maa, nani, bua, sharma ji, boss, friend… — else a seeded pick), expr: deadpan | side-eye | smug | proud | shocked (default per character), side 'left'|'right' (bubble tail side; side-eye looks that way, default 'left'), frameWidth (default 620). Frame is tossed in on the cut; the bubble pops 4 frames later; the character blinks.

params.speech: Dekha? Didi ko 20 lakh ka package!
params.caption: didi

example.speech: Dekha? Didi ko 20 lakh ka package!
example.caption: didi
